relation: the disjoint union of two graphs on the sum carrier, each summand keeping its own adjacency and nothing across. Simple graphs: Chromatic X66 x66_disjoint_union_rel/x66_disjoint_union are upstream GraphTheory join_rel/sjoin (despite its name the disjoint union), the relation by conversion and the graph pointwise and by the identity isomorphism; the two constructor proofs are related through the graphs they build (eq_diso), never by proof-field equality. Digraphs: Digraph X2 x2_disjoint_union/x2_disjoint_union_rel are Digraph.constructions.digraph_sum digraph_sum/digraph_sum_rel over the existing Finite/HasArc core (no proof fields): the carrier, the relation, every arc and the packaged diGraphType convert. Loops and asymmetric arcs of a summand are kept and either summand may be empty; a join (heroes.djoin, X122 x122_dijoin) is not this construction.
summary: Batch A, family A28 (disjoint unions), on Arthur's A27 pin ec5fb25. Simple graphs reuse upstream GraphTheory join_rel/sjoin (sum carrier, no edge across; join_rel_sym/irrefl, sjoin_disconnected, join_is_forest): X66's x66_disjoint_union_rel and x66_disjoint_union are now aliases and its two constructor proofs one-line uses of the upstream ones. Digraphs get the focused public Digraph.constructions.digraph_sum (no conjecture import, no guard): the carrier D1 + D2 with Finite.on and a HasArc instance, arcs inside each summand and none across, both injection and both cross-arc equations and the cardinal sum; X2's Section DisjointUnion now aliases it with the same packaging. Two public clients cover empty summands on either side, a loop, an asymmetric arc and the forest bridge.

Frozen verbatim at ec5fb25: X66's relation, both constructor proofs with their scripts, the graph and the complete good-trees row (both tree guards, both goodness premises); X2's entire Section DisjointUnion (alias, anonymous Finite/HasArc packaging, relation) and its current row. The complete X2 Original at B1's baseline 9e03072 joins this frozen sum with B1's raw X2MaderianLegacy.delta_plus_maderian (nonempty host, minimum out-degree, complete subdivision model); B1's five raw providers are borrowed as historical objects. Fourteen mappings, three whole iffs.

Proof consumers: implications_X66's x66_union_forest and the gc:e036 theorem, the X2 grounding/implication files, X16, X17, X52, X90, X107, directed_kneser_nonexistence and the B1/B2 certificates recompile unchanged. B1's X2UnionLegacy.statement keeps the live sum (documented snapshot); A28's per-row X2 copy keeps B1/B2's live chain (reciprocal notes in both specs).
